investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardpath News (news and media publishing); Platform: Google Cloud us-central1 (zones us-central1-a/us-central1-b/us-central1-c/us-central1-f); network range 10.245.0.0/16; Database: subscribers-db-01 holds subscribers records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Argo Workflows and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
